描述_EN: by the twentieth century the shapes and styles of the traditional dress were changing. the qipao was traditionally the costume of the manchu people, and the style was adopted by chinese women from the qing dynasty. neat, slightly waisted jackets paired with above-ankle skirts were prevalent in the 1920s.
描述_ZN: 到了二十世纪，传统服装的形状和样式都在发生变化。 旗袍在传统上是满族人的服装，这种风格从清朝开始被中国妇女采用。 在20世纪20年代，宽大的、略带腰身的外套与脚踝以上的裙子搭配是很流行的。
